# grazer

`grazer` provides practical tools for livestock GPS analysis in grazing
systems. The current package covers validation, quality control,
cleaning, track segmentation, movement, spatial use, resource use,
social proximity, mapping, and GPS-derived activity states.

The public API uses short `gps_*` function names. Future livestock
sensor modules may use the `acc_*`, `vf_*`, `rs_*`, and `fusion_*`
prefixes when those workflows are ready.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("wobblytwilliams/grazer")
```

## GPS data

Most functions expect a data frame with four standard columns:

| Column      | Meaning                                              |
|-------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `sensor_id` | Collar, sensor, or data-stream identifier            |
| `datetime`  | Fix time as `POSIXct` or a parseable datetime string |
| `lon`       | Longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84                  |
| `lat`       | Latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84                   |

Additional study fields such as `animal_id`, `deployment_id`, `paddock`,
and `treatment` are retained where possible.

## Basic workflow

``` r

library(grazer)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Import the collar data, then rename the required fields once.
gps_raw <- read_csv("path/to/gps.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename(
    sensor_id = collar_id,
    datetime = fix_time,
    lon = longitude,
    lat = latitude
  )

# Confirm that the required columns and values have the expected format.
validation <- gps_validate(
  gps_raw,
  drop_invalid = TRUE,
  large_gap_mins = 60,
  groups = "sensor_id"
)
print(validation)

gps_valid <- validation$data

# Inspect row-level errors, duplicates, sampling gaps, and time intervals.
qc <- gps_qc_summary(
  gps_valid,
  large_gap_mins = 60,
  groups = "sensor_id"
)
print(qc)

# Split each sensor track where a large time gap occurs. The resulting
# segment_id combines the sensor identifier and continuous segment number.
gps_segmented <- gps_append_segments(
  gps_valid,
  large_gap_mins = 60,
  groups = "sensor_id"
)

# Apply the selected cleaning steps within continuous track segments.
gps_cleaned <- gps_clean(
  gps_segmented,
  steps = c("duplicates", "errors", "speed_stat", "denoise"),
  action = "drop",
  groups = "segment_id"
)

# Calculate daily movement metrics. Step calculations remain separated by
# segment_id, so distances are not calculated across large gaps.
daily_movement <- gps_movement_summary(
  gps_cleaned,
  epoch = "day",
  groups = c("sensor_id", "animal_id")
)

daily_movement |>
  select(sensor_id, animal_id, epoch_start, n_fixes, total_distance_m)
```

Functions return `data.frame` by default. Cleaning, regularisation, and
model functions retain useful diagnostics in documented attributes. The
complete development walkthrough is available in
[`dev/public-function-walkthrough.R`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/dev/public-function-walkthrough.R).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`gps_activity_state()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_activity_state.md)
  : Classify GPS activity state
- [`gps_animal_summary()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_animal_summary.md)
  : Summarise GPS metrics by animal or sensor
- [`gps_append_paddock_names()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_append_paddock_names.md)
  : Append paddock names to GPS fixes
- [`gps_append_segments()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_append_segments.md)
  : Append continuous GPS segment identifiers
- [`gps_check_gaps()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_check_gaps.md)
  : Check GPS track gaps
- [`gps_clean()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean.md)
  : Clean GPS data using a selected sequence of steps
- [`gps_clean_duplicates()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean_duplicates.md)
  : Drop or flag duplicate GPS fixes
- [`gps_clean_errors()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean_errors.md)
  : Clean row-level GPS data errors
- [`gps_clean_spatial()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean_spatial.md)
  : Spatial cleaning using paddock or boundary polygons
- [`gps_clean_speed_fixed()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean_speed_fixed.md)
  : Clean GPS speed outliers using a fixed threshold
- [`gps_clean_speed_stat()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_clean_speed_stat.md)
  : Clean GPS speed outliers using a data-driven threshold
- [`gps_contacts()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_contacts.md)
  : Calculate GPS contact events
- [`gps_denoise()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_denoise.md)
  : Denoise GPS jitter using statistical or state-aware smoothing
- [`gps_diurnal()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_diurnal.md)
  : Summarise GPS metrics by date and hour
- [`gps_downsample()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_downsample.md)
  : Downsample GPS fixes to a lower frequency
- [`gps_epoch()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_epoch.md)
  : Join GPS epoch summaries
- [`gps_group_summary()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_group_summary.md)
  : Summarise GPS metrics by group or herd metadata
- [`gps_hotspots()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_hotspots.md)
  : Identify GPS high-use grid cells
- [`gps_interpolate()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_interpolate.md)
  : Interpolate GPS fixes on a regular time grid
- [`gps_kde()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_kde.md)
  : Calculate GPS kernel-density space use
- [`gps_map()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_map.md)
  : Map GPS fixes interactively
- [`gps_mcp()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_mcp.md)
  : Calculate GPS minimum convex polygon summaries
- [`gps_movement_summary()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_movement_summary.md)
  : Summarise GPS movement by epoch
- [`gps_nearest_neighbour()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_nearest_neighbour.md)
  : Calculate GPS nearest-neighbour distance
- [`gps_neighbours_within_range()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_neighbours_within_range.md)
  : Count GPS neighbours within distance thresholds
- [`gps_playback()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_playback.md)
  : Playback GPS tracks on a leaflet timeline with tails
- [`gps_proximity()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_proximity.md)
  : Calculate pairwise GPS proximity by timestamp
- [`gps_qc_summary()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_qc_summary.md)
  : Summarise GPS quality control
- [`gps_regularise()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_regularise.md)
  : Regularise GPS fixes to expected times
- [`gps_resource_distance()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_resource_distance.md)
  : Calculate distance from GPS fixes to resources
- [`gps_resource_use()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_resource_use.md)
  : Summarise GPS use near resources
- [`gps_resource_visits()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_resource_visits.md)
  : Detect GPS visits to resources
- [`gps_social()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_social.md)
  : Calculate standard GPS social proximity metrics
- [`gps_social_summary()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_social_summary.md)
  : Summarise GPS social metrics by epoch
- [`gps_spatial()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_spatial.md)
  : Summarise GPS spatial use by epoch
- [`gps_steps()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_steps.md)
  : Calculate GPS step-level movement metrics
- [`gps_turning()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_turning.md)
  : Calculate GPS turning angles
- [`gps_validate()`](https://wobblytwilliams.github.io/grazer/reference/gps_validate.md)
  : Validate GPS data
